title: FactoryEquipmentStateV1
description: Gateway-OBSERVED equipment state. Topic: factory.equipment-states.v1, key: equipmentId, compacted. Produced exclusively by edge-gateway. Consumed by safety-supervisor for gate 10. v0.2 required this input ('predictions plus required equipment state') but defined no contract for it (GAP-031).

transitionId.description: T1..T16 from EQUIPMENT_MODEL_AND_STATE.md 3.2. Absent on a refresh record, which reports no transition (OD-008). null only for an observed change that is not representable as one transition - an intermediate state the observer never saw (OD-010).

stateSequence.description: Scope: per equipmentId, assigned by the EDGE GATEWAY (not the equipment). Named distinctly from telemetry `sequence`, which is equipment-assigned, so the two can never be confused.

gatewayEpoch.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, taken once at gateway process start (OD-008). Pairs with stateSequence, which restarts whenever the gateway does: duplicate identity is (equipmentId, gatewayEpoch, stateSequence), so a restarted counter cannot collide with records from a previous run. NOT an ordering signal - epochs from different gateways are not comparable and a consumer must never sort by it.

observedBy.description: Gateway instance identity. Present so a consumer can never mistake an observed state for equipment ground truth - a gateway that cannot reach a healthy machine reports OFFLINE while the machine is in fact RUNNING.

aiEligible.description: Derived: true only when state == RUNNING. Required so the Supervisor's gate is a field read rather than a re-derivation (OD-010).

activeConditions.description: Not emitted by the edge gateway: neither protocol carries the equipment's conditions (OT_PROTOCOL_MAPPING.md, register +22 and the OPC UA address space). Absent until the protocol mapping carries condition identity for both protocols; a producer must not infer it (OD-010).
